mapper.sql: id, code, value, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user and top_user_id = #{topId} ) as total_user, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user u where u.register_time > #{startTime} and u.register_time <= #{endTime} and u.user_group = 0 and u.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as today_total_user, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.apply_amount), 0) FROM app_user_cash_in_order r where r.cash_status = 5 and r.user_group = 0 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as total_cash_in, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.apply_amount), 0) FROM app_user_cash_in_order r where r.cash_status = 5 and r.remit_time > #{startTime} and r.remit_time <= #{endTime} and r.user_group = 0 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as today_cash_in, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.actual_amount), 0) FROM app_user_cash_out_order r where r.cash_status = 5 and r.user_group = 0 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as total_cash_out, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r.actual_amount), 0) FROM app_user_cash_out_order r where r.cash_status = 5 and r.remit_time > #{startTime} and r.remit_time <= #{endTime} and r.user_group = 0 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as today_cash_out, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_position r where r.buy_order_time > #{startTime} and r.buy_order_time <= #{endTime} and r.agentId = #{topId} ) as today_orders

select (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_position r where r.`status` = 1 and r.agentId = #{topId} ) as order_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_cash_in_order r where r.cash_status = 1 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as cash_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_cash_out_order r where r.cash_status = 1 and r.top_user_id = #{topId} ) as cash_out_count
